description: Change block storage instance (resize volume and/or update name/description). Supports both Gen2 (XEN) and Gen3 (KVM). For attached storage, server must be stopped to resize.

blockStorageInstanceNo.description: Block storage instance number to change

blockStorageSize.description: New block storage size in GB (XEN: 10~2000, KVM: 10~16380, 10GB increments, must be >= current size)

name: ncloud_change_block_storage
